g.text: TO FLARE HEADER / FLARE KO DRUM
HS-003 OVERRIDE · HS-004 SIS RESET · HS-005 OPEN SDV-101
HS-006/007 SDV-124/134 RESET · HS-008 BDV RESET (SHT 2)
CONTROL VALVE, DIAPHRAGM · FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
SHUTDOWN / BLOWDOWN VALVE (SDV / BDV), SPRING RETURN
CHOKE VALVE C/W POSITIONER (HV), SET BY HIC
GATE / BALL VALVE · LO LC NC CSO = LOCKED OPEN / LOCKED
CHECK VALVE (NRV), FLOW LEFT TO RIGHT
PRESSURE SAFETY VALVE, SPRING, ANGLE BODY
HOLD: RECOMMENDED BY HAZOP (Rnn), NOT IN THE MODEL
DISPLACER CAGE (LT) / GAUGE GLASS (LG) ON BRIDLE
CD CLOSED DRAIN · SP SAMPLE POINT · MV MANUAL VALVE · N NOZZLE
SIS SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SYSTEM · ESD EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN
FL = FAIL LAST (HV-100 IN THE MODEL; HOLD)
GENERAL NOTES (DESIGN CASE = SIMULATOR MODEL AT DESIGN, snapDesign)
1. WELL STREAM 30 BAR G / 35 °C: OIL 40 m³/h (810 kg/m³) · WATER 20 m³/h (1010 kg/m³) · GAS 12.0 kSm³/h (MW 21, Z 0.96, 8.97 kg/m³ AT 10 BAR G 50 °C).
2. BALANCE: IN 63.26 t/h = GAS 10.66 + OIL 32.59 + WATER 20.02 t/h (CLOSURE +0.005 %). E-101 737 kW = STEAM 1264 kg/h × 2100 kJ/kg.
4. V-101 DESIGN 12.0 BAR G / 80 °C (MOP 11.0). PSV-119 SET 12.0, 6.5 kg/s (MODEL), REQUIRED 2484 mm² → API "N" ORIFICE (4N6); RELIEF CASES HOLD (R01, R18).
5. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (SCH 40): LIQUID ≤ 2 m/s, OUTLET NOZZLES ≤ 1 m/s; GAS ≤ 20 m/s; TWO-PHASE < 0.8 Ve (API RP 14E, C = 100); STEAM ≤ 35 m/s;
FLARE MACH ≤ 0.5 (HEADER) / 0.7 (TAIL PIPE) AT 0.3 BAR G; INLET NOZZLE ρv² ≤ 2100 Pa. ALL CHECKED AT DESIGN AND +20 % (NEW WELL); SEE LINE LIST.
6. E-101 TUBE SIDE AND DN250-PF-102 REACH 148 °C (STEAM) WITH NO FLOW: DESIGN T HOLD UNTIL TSHH-103 (R07) IS DECIDED. NO VALVE BETWEEN E-101 AND V-101.
7. ALL INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP.). BRIDLE ISOLATION AND DRAIN VALVES TYP. NOT TAGGED. SPADES AT EVERY BATTERY LIMIT (R25).
8. LEVELS IN mm ABOVE VESSEL BOTTOM. LT-125/126/127 ARE GUIDED-WAVE RADAR ON OWN NOZZLES; SIS TRANSMITTERS INDEPENDENT OF THE DCS.
9. TAGS, SET POINTS AND LIMITS FROM THE OTS PAGE (K, ALM, makeCtrls, tripConditions); NEW VALVES MV-, NRV-, SP-, ST- AND LINES ARE THIS SHEET'S.
10. DASHED BUBBLES = HOLD ITEMS RECOMMENDED BY THE HAZOP (Rnn), NOT IN THE MODEL.
N1 INLET DN300 (ρv² 1140 Pa) · N2 GAS OUT DN250 · N3 PV-111 DN200
N4 PSV-119 DN150 · N5 BDV-118 DN80 · N6 WATER DN100 (0.67 m/s)
N7 OIL DN150 (0.60 m/s) · N8 DRAIN DN50 · N9 SAND DN80
N10 SAND JET DN50 · N11 VENT DN50 · LT/PT NOZZLES DN50
M1 MANWAY DN600 (NOT SHOWN) · BRIDLES DN50
SERVICE CODES: PF PROCESS FLUID · GP GAS · FL FLARE · OL OIL
PW PRODUCED WATER · SJ SAND-JET · DR DRAIN · CI CHEMICAL
LS LP STEAM · SC CONDENSATE · NG NITROGEN
LINE NO. DNxxx-SVC-nnn; LINE LIST: tabs/pidalt/dwg/lines.json
P&ID — THREE-PHASE SEPARATOR V-101 · ALTERNATIVE VERSION
TO K-201 EXPORT COMPRESSOR · 8.0 BAR G
DEMULSIFIER INJECTION (0.8 L/h = 20 ppm ON OIL, MODEL FIC-105 SP)
FROM THE MODEL: tripConditions(), bmsTrip(), outTrip(), bmsCmd(), step() · C&E SEP-V101-IN-CE-001
· NO INLET TRIP ACTIVE (PSHH-114, LSHH-127, PSLL-115 UNLESS INHIBITED)
· PIC-110 AND PIC-111 NOT IN MAN · BDV-118 CLOSED
· HIC-100 AT 30 % OR LESS · LI-125 BELOW 1250 mm
SIS RESET (HS-004) IS REFUSED WHILE AN INLET TRIP IS ACTIVE OR BDV-118 IS OPEN.
INLET TRIPS CLOSE SDV-101 ONLY; TIC-102 THEN CLOSES TV-102 (CONTROL, NOT SIS).
TRIP SETTINGS: K.PSHH, K.PSLL, K.LSHH, K.LSLLi, K.LSLLo, K.Psv / K.Psvr.
LEVEL TRIPS READ THE TRUE LEVEL IN THE MODEL (TRANSMITTERS ASSUMED).
TSHH-103 / TT-103 (R07): E-101 OUTLET HIGH-HIGH → CLOSE STEAM
SDV-109 (R27): GAS LINE TO K-201, FAIL CLOSED, STOPS BACK-FLOW
LT-105 / LAL-105 (R04): T-105 LEVEL, LOW ALARM
PSV-105 (R05): P-105 DISCHARGE RELIEF · PSV-162 (R06): E-101 SHELL
LSHH-128 (R10): INTERFACE HIGH-HIGH ON OWN SENSOR (NOT DRAWN)
LINE LIST (PRELIMINARY · FULL LIST IN lines.json)
12.0 up to PV-111; flare class after
1. I-1 … I-5 AS SCHEDULED (RIGHT). I-1 CLOSES SDV-101 ONLY; ESD-1/2 ALSO CLOSE SDV-124 / SDV-134 AND DRIVE LIC-120 / LIC-130 OUTPUTS TO 0 %.
2. FAIL POSITIONS ON INSTRUMENT-AIR LOSS (MODEL step()): TV-102 FC, PV-110 FO, PV-111 FO, LV-120 FC, LV-130 FC, SDV-101/124/134 FC, BDV-118 FO.
3. PIC-110 10.0 BAR G → PV-110 TO K-201; PIC-111 11.0 BAR G → PV-111 TO FLARE (NORMALLY CLOSED, TAKES THE GAS WHEN K-201 TRIPS).
4. LIC-120 HOLDS THE INTERFACE AT 550 mm (WATER BY LV-120); OIL SPILLS OVER THE WEIR; LIC-130 HOLDS THE BUCKET AT 600 mm (LV-130).
5. TIC-102 50 °C → TV-102; FIC-105 0.8 L/h → P-105 STROKE. HIC-100 SETS THE CHOKE FROM THE DCS (MODEL: FAIL LAST, HOLD).
6. LV-120 / LV-130 BYPASSES LOCKED CLOSED, PSV-119 ISOLATION CAR-SEALED OPEN, GAUGE GLASSES ARMOURED WITH BALL CHECKS (R30).
7. SPEC BREAK AT EACH CONTROL VALVE TO A LOWER-PRESSURE SYSTEM: DOWNSTREAM RATING HOLD UNTIL THE GAS BLOW-BY CASES ARE SIZED (R13, R14).
8. TSV-121 / TSV-131 PROTECT LIQUID BLOCKED IN BETWEEN SDV AND LV (SAFETY-LAYERS REGISTER, ASSUMED). NRV-187/192 STOP BACK-FLOW.
9. FI-119 = LIQUID DRAINED FROM V-201 (CARRY-OVER); LSHH-201 TRIPS K-201 AT 90 % (360 L), LI-201 H 60 %. KI-116 = DCS CALCULATION.
H1 WELL SHUT-IN PRESSURE AND CLASS UP TO HV-100 (R03).
H2 PSV-119 RELIEF CASES, FIRE CASE, SPARE PSV (R01, R18).
H3 FLARE LOAD, BACK PRESSURE, TAIL-PIPE SIZE (R19).
H4 BLOWDOWN: RO-118 BORE, MIN. METAL TEMP. (R17).
H5 TSHH-103 + STEAM SDV (R07); E-101 TUBE DESIGN T.
H6 PSV-162 E-101 SHELL OR 2/3 RULE (R06).
H7 LP SEP. / HYDROCYCLONE BLOW-BY RELIEF, RO (R13, R14).
H8 SDV-109 ON GAS TO K-201 (R27); PSV-105 (R05).
H9 HV-100 FAIL ACTION; LT-126/127 SENSOR TYPE.
H10 LINE SIZES, CLASSES, NOZZLE ORIENTATION: TBC.
